title: M2 not met: cold CLI plan 0.96–1.41 s at 100k tasks (target < 300 ms)
what: M2 (cold CLI plan under 300 ms at 100k tasks) is not met. Measured 0.96 to 1.41 s. The dominant cost is parsing the 53 MB `tg.idx`, which is essentially a copy of the log.
why: DECISIONS.md D-E2-01 / Reverse indexes section: a real fix is a binary index image with postings stored in it (implemented as format 2, but M2 cold path still misses).
impact: Cold CLI plan latency exceeds target at scale.
workaround: Binary index image format 2 built (improves to ~80 ms for `affected`, ~90 ms for `stats`), but M2 cold path still not measured as met.
